adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, the update path is gated by `if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1` and only then calls `PostRevisor#revise!` and `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)`. The added spec (`spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`) covers creation and a changed-content update (`"muhahaha new contents!"`) but does not cover the unchanged-content case (re-import identical `contents` should *not* revise). It also doesn’t assert that `embed.content_sha1` was refreshed via `update_column` or that no extra revisions are created, so a regression that re-revises every hourly poll could pass. This is a concrete missing-test gap around newly introduced change-detection logic, not a proven runtime defect in the diff itself.
